gloss: painting (on ceramics, pottery); decorating with designs

definitions.gloss: painting designs on ceramics or pottery; decorative painting
definitions.explanation: The craft of applying decorative patterns or pictures onto pottery, porcelain, or other ceramics, either before or after glazing.

examples.english: To try one's hand at ceramic painting.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧ (picture, painting) and ⟦{付|つ}け→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (applying, attaching). Refers to the craft of painting decorative patterns or pictures onto pottery, porcelain, or other ceramics before or after glazing. A key step in traditional Japanese pottery production. Often offered as an activity at pottery studios and tourist destinations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絵付|えつ}け⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: ceramic painting experience
- {絵付|えつ}け{師|し}: ceramic painter (artisan)
- {手描|てが}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絵付|えつ}け: hand-painted decoration
- {下絵付|したえつ}け: underglaze painting (applied before glazing)
- {上絵付|うわえつ}け: overglaze painting (applied after initial firing)
